limitations: These 27 observations are sampled fee findings, not a complete fee or obligation count. Eleven unresolved chains remain explicit.
Published fee rows, deposits, estimates and pass-through costs are distinct; no total project-cost calculator is produced.
Source records and immutable originals are referenced through the coverage ledger rather than duplicated here.
Native citations must match source-page text; scanned citations must exactly match a separately hashed checked-excerpt record bound to actual OCR page bytes.
Machine OCR of all fee supplement pages is preserved separately. Specified excerpt checks do not certify entire pages or legal currentness.
